overall: The AG found no violation. Purpose 1 permits executive session for personnel matters but never requires it, so discussing them in open session was not a violation.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly discussed a police lieutenant's job performance, complaints about her, and a union no-confidence vote in open session instead of executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing matters in open session that may have been appropriate for executive session.
